name: 104. Web Search API Source Round-Trip (#7356)
description: OpenAI Responses web search can return specialized API sources in web_search_call.action.sources ({"type":"api","name":"oai-weather"}) that carry a name and no URL; the published OpenAPI schema does not model them yet (openai/openai-openapi#573). Bifrost's typed source schema had no name field and a required url, so a decode/re-encode round-trip dropped name and fabricated an empty url, and the OpenAI request-side source sanitization rebuilt sources without name. The case pins the client-visible path: replaying a completed web_search_call in input through POST /v1/responses must be accepted with the api source intact. Red/green note: pre-fix the replayed api source reached OpenAI as {"type":"api","url":""}; whether OpenAI rejects that shape depends on server-side validation this case cannot control, so the primary pin is post-fix acceptance of the corrected shape.

exec: pm.test('web search api source replay accepted - #7356', function () {
pm.test('response body is valid json - #7356', function () {

body.raw: {"model":"openai/gpt-4o","max_output_tokens":16,"input":[{"type":"web_search_call","id":"ws_7356","status":"completed","action":{"type":"search","queries":["weather in paris"],"sources":[{"type":"url","url":"https://example.com/weather"},{"type":"api","name":"oai-weather"}]}},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the search results above in one sentence."}]}
